source.title: I care – Pflege
source.basis: Uploaded textbook only; no external clinical facts merged.

notes: P6 manually calibrated content preserved.
P7 source signals were re-routed by PDF section position where possible.
Mass cards were deterministically reconstructed from source evidence and subjected to global mechanical/content-shape QA.
Items failing P7B gates are excluded from production rather than silently shipped.
Current-guidance modernization is not part of this source-faithful bank.
P9 repairs textbook section hierarchy and false-caption routing.
P10 branding finalized as PflegeLern for repository /pflegelern and GitHub Pages release.
P13 expands the source-faithful application bank to 120 cases.
P14-P19 preserve calibrated flashcard assessment, free recall, exam planning, adaptive mix, Mastery Model v2 and bounded remediation.
P20 provides Mock Exam System v2 while preserving P16-P19 contracts.
P23 replaces the generic AI-style visual language with the restrained Editorial Clinical UI.

P24 repairs responsive navigation and breakpoint regressions, removes effective mobile header blur, strengthens light/dark control borders, isolates PflegeLern service-worker cache cleanup, makes backup restore replace all learning stores even for older backups, synchronizes PWA colors/icons and visible version metadata, and adds real Chromium browser QA at 320, 375, 768, 912, 959, 1024 and 1440 px. Learning content, FSRS scheduling, mastery, remediation and exam scoring remain unchanged.

P25A rebalances question variety without altering the 954 certified legacy questions: +320 source-card short-answer items, +24 source-card matching items and +1 strictly source-ordered sequence items. P17 now plans objective/application subtypes explicitly before score-based selection, while P20 remains objectively scored only.

P25B adds bounded question repetition control for recommended, quick, continuation and scoped automatic study. It reads existing questionHistory plus recent study-session exposure, strongly suppresses exact same-question repeats when a same-type alternative exists, gracefully falls back for genuinely narrow pools, records abandoned-session exposure through the existing sessions store, and does not mutate FSRS scheduling, mastery evidence, remediation contracts or mock-exam scoring.

P25C certifies that every question in the 1,299-item bank has a viable answer-input contract and adds browser-level desktop/mobile interaction coverage for radio, checkbox, ordering, matching and free-response controls. Free-response drafts are synchronously protected before the legacy debounced persistence path, preventing typed text from being lost when a learner immediately checks, exits, navigates or refreshes. Grading, FSRS scheduling, mastery, remediation and exam selection remain unchanged.

P25D adds a non-destructive question-quality gate for answer-choice questions. Structurally weak or giveaway-prone legacy items are replaced in automatic study/scoped study/mock exams by stronger same-type, same-scope alternatives when available. Single-choice answer positions use deterministic balanced-slot ordering rather than relying only on unconstrained shuffling. The 1,299-item source-faithful bank itself is unchanged; FSRS, mastery, remediation and grading semantics remain unchanged.

P26A performs detection-only semantic auditing across all 1,299 questions and materializes a deterministic defect registry tied to the frozen question-bank SHA-256. Unit/context-aware precision refinement confirms 7 high-confidence semantic defects and records 108 additional manual-review candidates without changing any question text, answer key, explanation, difficulty, FSRS scheduling, mastery, remediation or exam scoring.

P26B corrects only the seven high-confidence semantic defects certified by P26A: two overlapping numeric single-choice items, four non-discriminating all-correct multiple-choice items, and one near-equivalent distractor. Every correction is grounded in existing textbook-derived concepts/cards; the 108 P26A manual-review candidates are preserved for later adjudication. Question IDs, types, concept anchors, difficulty, FSRS scheduling, mastery, remediation and mock-exam logic remain unchanged.

P26C adjudicates all 108 lower-confidence P26A manual-review candidates against repository-local question, concept and source-card evidence without editing the question bank. It clears source-card length heuristics, intentional matching-template reuse and two already-contextualized case prompts when repository evidence resolves the signal; it promotes 14 persistent single-choice issues to a bounded repair queue (12 distractor-design defects and 2 answer-option-subsumption defects). No candidates remain unresolved, the seven P26B corrections stay closed, and no external clinical guidance, FSRS, mastery, remediation, repetition-control or mock-exam behavior changes are introduced.

P26D repairs exactly the 14 questions confirmed by P26C. Two overlapping answer-option defects are replaced with distinct textbook-derived alternatives, and twelve giveaway-prone distractor sets are replaced with topic-local source-card-backed distractors. Question IDs, types, target concepts, difficulty, correct option IDs, source anchors and explanations are preserved. No external clinical guidance is introduced, and FSRS, mastery, remediation, repetition control, input handling and mock-exam logic remain unchanged.

P26E closes the P26 semantic-audit chain without editing the question bank. It preserves the conservative P26A detector as a raw historical regression oracle and proves that its 94 remaining live review signals are exactly the 94 P26C-cleared, non-actionable heuristics; all seven P26A confirmed defects remain closed through P26B, all 14 P26C repair targets remain closed through P26D, and actionable defects, unadjudicated signals, pending repairs and stale repair targets are all zero.

P26F audits all 1,299 questions against their repository-local concept, card, section and source provenance. It recovers the missing textbook hierarchy entries 3.2.2 Kurative Pflege and 8.1.1 Was ist Stress?, corrects five concept source anchors and two P12 question source snapshots, and closes the full-bank source-alignment audit with zero actionable or review findings. Question IDs, types, prompts, options, answer keys, explanations, difficulty and all learning-system behavior remain unchanged; no external clinical guidance is added.

P26G freezes and certifies the complete 1,299-question bank after the P25/P26 quality chain. The frozen bank hash, six-type distribution, reference graph, answer-input contracts, semantic closure, source alignment, repetition control, question-quality selection, mock-exam compatibility and desktop/mobile interaction paths are validated together. P26G does not edit question learning content; any future bank change must invalidate and regenerate the final certification.

P27A audits full-product release readiness after the P26G bank freeze. It intentionally does not modify the frozen 1,299-question bank or learning behavior. The audit checks production/PWA integrity, core route/browser behavior, release documentation, QA entrypoints and release identity, and records detected release-truth drift for P27B repair.

P27B repairs release truth after the P27A audit: README/QA counts and identity are current, the learner-facing version and service-worker cache are aligned to 1.1.0-rc.1, and tools/release_readiness.py is the canonical validation entrypoint. The frozen P26G 1,299-question bank and all learning behavior remain unchanged.
